intro.heading: Happy Fall!
intro.body:
The chapter met on Sunday to plan the semester’s events. Members shared ideas for service, study nights, and dinners with alumni. Everyone agreed that the house should feel “open to every guest” on event days.

Details and sign-up forms are posted at www.example.org for anyone who wants to help. Questions can go to the newsletter editor at editor@example.edu at any time.

donate.heading: HOW TO DONATE
donate.body:
Donations directly to the Nu Chapter, a 501(c)(7) organization, can be made through Zelle at the following account: calthetaxi@gmail.com
Tax deductible donations can be made to the Theta Xi Foundation, a 501(c)(3) organization, contact NAM_Pres@comcast.net or go to ThetaXi.org and click on “Give,” for more information
